_sections.questItems: 10. Quest item chat responses (involved vs uninvolved NPC lines)

keywords.hail: I greet thee, my loyal subject Player.
keywords.hello: I greet thee, my loyal subject Player.
keywords.salutations: I greet thee, my loyal subject Player.
keywords.benjamin: He was once my greatest general. Now he is very old and senile so we assigned him to work for the Royal Tibia Mail.
keywords.bozo: He is my royal jester and cheers me up now and then.
keywords.carlin: They dare to reject my reign over the whole continent!
keywords.city north: They dare to reject my reign over the whole continent!
keywords.chester: A very competent person. A little nervous but very competent.
keywords.citizen: The citizens of Tibia are my subjects. Ask the old monk Quentin if you want to learn more about them.
keywords.druid: We need druidic healing powers to fight evil.
keywords.druids: We need druidic healing powers to fight evil.
keywords.marvik: We need druidic healing powers to fight evil.
keywords.dungeon: Dungeons are no places for kings.
keywords.eclesius: What a shame, he was a skilled mage once.
keywords.enemy: Our enemies are numerous. The evil minotaurs, Ferumbras, and the renegade city of Carlin to the north are just some of them.
keywords.enemies: Our enemies are numerous. The evil minotaurs, Ferumbras, and the renegade city of Carlin to the north are just some of them.
keywords.eremo: It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
keywords.equipment: Feel free to buy it in our town's fine shops.
keywords.evil: We need all the strength we can muster to smite evil!
keywords.excalibug: It's the sword of the Kings. If you return this weapon to me I will reward you beyond your wildest dreams.
falcon: As a young prince I have heard high tales of the Order of the Falcon. It was a topic in history lessons as well. As far as I know, their significance faded after a dispute with my father King Xenom.
Their stronghold to the north is still largely intact and we left it alone for the most part. People tend to avoid it as the Order's disappearance was never truly solved.
keywords.ferumbras: He is a follower of the evil God Zathroth and responsible for many attacks on us. Kill him on sight!
keywords.first dragon: The dragon was ancient beyond compare. Eventually even he had to succumb to old age and flew to the dragon cemetery to die there. Or so it is told.
keywords.food: Ask the royal cook for some food.
keywords.frodo: He is the owner of Frodo's Hut and a faithful tax-payer.
keywords.god: Honour the Gods and above all pay your taxes.
keywords.gods: Honour the Gods and above all pay your taxes.
keywords.gold: To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
keywords.money: To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
keywords.tax: To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
keywords.taxes: To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
keywords.good: The forces of good are hard pressed in these dark times.
keywords.gorn: He was once one of Tibia's greatest fighters. Now he sells equipment.
keywords.guild: The four major guilds are the knights, the paladins, the druids, and the sorcerers.
keywords.guilds: The four major guilds are the knights, the paladins, the druids, and the sorcerers.
keywords.harkath: Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious army.
keywords.bloodblade: Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious army.
keywords.general: Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious army.
keywords.help: Visit Quentin the monk for help.
keywords.job: I am your sovereign, King Tibianus III of Thais, and it's my duty to uphold justice and provide guidance for my subjects.
keywords.subject: I am your sovereign, King Tibianus III of Thais, and it's my duty to uphold justice and provide guidance for my subjects.
keywords.justice: I try my best to be just and fair to our citizens. The army and the TBI are a great help in fulfilling this duty.
keywords.king: I am the king, so watch what you say!
keywords.knight: The brave knights are necessary to protect the denizens of Thais.
keywords.knights: The brave knights are necessary to protect the denizens of Thais.
keywords.gregor: The brave knights are necessary to protect the denizens of Thais.
keywords.minotaur: Vile monsters, but I must admit they are strong and sometimes even cunning ... in their own bestial way.
keywords.minotaurs: Vile monsters, but I must admit they are strong and sometimes even cunning ... in their own bestial way.
keywords.monster: Go and hunt them! For king and country!
keywords.monsters: Go and hunt them! For king and country!
keywords.name: Preposterous! You must know the name of your own king!
keywords.news: The latest news is usually brought to our magnificent town by brave adventurers. They recount tales of their journeys at Frodo's tavern.
keywords.noodles: The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest treasure!
keywords.treasure: The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest treasure!
keywords.paladin: The paladins are the great protectors of Thais.
keywords.paladins: The paladins are the great protectors of Thais.
keywords.elane: The paladins are the great protectors of Thais.
keywords.reward: I don't see how you would deserve a reward right now.
keywords.sam: He is a skilled blacksmith and a loyal subject.
keywords.sell: Sell? Sell what? My kingdom isn't for sale!
keywords.shop: Visit the shops of our merchants and craftsmen.
keywords.shops: Visit the shops of our merchants and craftsmen.
keywords.sorcerer: The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
keywords.sorcerers: The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
keywords.muriel: The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
keywords.tax collector: That tax collector is the bane of my life. He is so lazy. I bet you haven't payed any taxes at all.
keywords.royal tax collector: That tax collector is the bane of my life. He is so lazy. I bet you haven't payed any taxes at all.
keywords.tbi: This organisation is an essential tool for holding our enemies in check. Its headquarter is located in the bastion in the northwall.
keywords.thais: Our beloved city has some fine shops, guildhouses and a modern sewerage system.
keywords.city: Our beloved city has some fine shops, guildhouses and a modern sewerage system.
keywords.tibia: Soon the whole land will be ruled by me once again!
keywords.land: Soon the whole land will be ruled by me once again!
keywords.kingsday: There are numerous good reasons for celebrations and to please my loyal subjects with a few happy days.
keywords.zathroth: Please ask a priest about the Gods.
keywords.al dee: I haven't seen Al Dee for a while and don't know where he holds house. Let me know if you have any information about him!

ironOre.default: Yes... Iron Ore! Let me know if you find one!
ironOre.missionConcluded: I appreciate your continued interest, but our business with iron ore is concluded.
ironOre.rewardGiven: Thank you for giving me an Iron Ore! Here's a small gift for you.
ironOre.fineRockNoMission: That's a fine looking rock you have there.
ironOre.fineRockMissionDone: I appreciate the rock, but I have no further use for iron ore now that our business is concluded.
ironOre.oreAccepted: Thank you! I'll give this to my guard... come back in a minute and I'll have something for you.
ironOre.repeatThankYou: Another thank you for this ore, hope you enjoy the small gift I gave you!

confusion: I do not understand what you mean, my subject.
Speak clearly, for I cannot comprehend your words.
Your meaning eludes me. Pray, explain yourself.
I am confused by your statement. What do you wish to convey?
These words make no sense to me. Clarify your intent.

swear.response: How dare you! Guards, remove this insolent subject!

keywords.hi: Hello, hello, Player! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of tools. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers!
keywords.hello: Hello, hello, Player! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of tools. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers!
keywords.how are you: I'm fine. I'm so glad to have you here as my customer.
keywords.tools: As an adventurer, you should always have at least a backpack, a rope, a shovel, a weapon, an armor and a shield.
keywords.offer: Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
keywords.trade: Take a look in the trade window below.
keywords.gold: Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to merchants to make profit!
keywords.money: Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to merchants to make profit!
keywords.backpack: Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a trade to view all my offers.
keywords.rope: Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a trade to view all my offers.
keywords.ropes: Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a trade to view all my offers.
keywords.shovel: Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a trade to view all my offers.
keywords.weapon: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's Obi's or Lee'Delle's business. I could offer you a pick in exchange for a small axe if you should happen to own one.
keywords.armor: Armor and shields can be bought at Dixi's or at Lee'Delle's. Dixi runs that shop near Obi's.
keywords.shield: Armor and shields can be bought at Dixi's or at Lee'Delle's. Dixi runs that shop near Obi's.
keywords.food: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be Willie or Billy. Norma also has some snacks for sale.
keywords.potions: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit Lily for that.
keywords.cookies: If you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
keywords.fishing: I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish — once you've delivered the king's stamped letter. Simply ask me for a trade.
keywords.cooking: If you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
keywords.fish: No thanks. I don't like fish.
keywords.torch: No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
keywords.worms: I have enough worms myself and don't want any more. Use them for fishing.
keywords.bone: You better put that bone back there where you dug it out.
keywords.help: If you bring me the king's stamped letter, I may have a task for you afterward.
keywords.information: If you need general equipment, just ask me for a trade. I can also provide you with some general hints about the game.
keywords.iron ore: Hmm... King Tibianus might be interested in this Iron Ore...
keywords.job: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
keywords.name: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a trade?
keywords.time: It's about 0:00 am. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
keywords.premium: As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
keywords.king: The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
keywords.sell: Just ask me for a trade to see what I buy from you.
keywords.wares: Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
keywords.stuff: Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
keywords.pick: Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?
keywords.small axe: Ah, my Small Axe! It fell into the cave waters while I was fleeing from minotaurs and goblins.
keywords.magnet: I do not sell magnets. King Tibianus may reward you with one if you bring him iron ore from Rookgaard.
keywords.dungeon: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the sewers, you have to equip yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's vital in the deepest sense of the word.
keywords.sewers: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by rats. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a trade to see it!
keywords.vital: Well, vital means - necessary for you to survive!
keywords.rats: Rats plague our sewers. You can sell fresh rat corpses to Seymour or Tom the tanner.
keywords.monsters: If you want to challenge monsters in the dungeons, you need some weapons and armor from the local merchants.
keywords.merchants: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a trade. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
keywords.tibia: One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
keywords.rookgaard: On the island of Rookgaard you can gather important experiences to prepare yourself for mainland.
keywords.mainland: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the oracle. You can choose a profession afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
keywords.profession: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the Island of Destiny.
keywords.island of destiny: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the oracle once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your profession!
keywords.academy: The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a bank and the room of the oracle. Seymour is the teacher there.
keywords.bank: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my wares!
keywords.oracle: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
keywords.temple: The monk Cipfried takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
keywords.citizen: If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
keywords.dallheim: Some call him a hero. He protects the town from monsters.
keywords.zerbrus: Some call him a hero. He protects the town from monsters.
keywords.al dee: Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
keywords.amber: She's currently recovering from her travels in the academy. It's always nice to chat with her!
keywords.billy: This is a local farmer. If you need fresh food to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with premium adventurers though.
keywords.cipfried: He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.
keywords.dixi: She's Obi's granddaughter and deals with armors and shields. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
keywords.hyacinth: He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
keywords.lee delle: If you are a premium adventurer, you should check out Lee'Delle's shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
keywords.lily: She sells health potions and antidote potions. Also, she buys blueberries and cookies in case you find any.
keywords.norma: She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
keywords.obi: He sells weapons. His shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
keywords.santiago: He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
keywords.seymour: Seymour is a teacher running the academy. He has much important information about Tibia.
keywords.tom: He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
keywords.willie: This is a local farmer. If you need fresh food to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick blueberries.
keywords.zirella: Poor old woman, her son Tom never visits her.
keywords.mission: Bring me the king's stamped letter first. After that, I may have another task for you.
keywords.missions: Bring me the king's stamped letter first. After that, I may have another task for you.
keywords.quest: Bring me the king's stamped letter first. After that, I may have another task for you.
keywords.task: Bring me the king's stamped letter first. After that, I may have another task for you.
keywords.axe: Ah, my Small Axe! It fell into the cave waters while I was fleeing from minotaurs and goblins.
keywords.elvenhair rope: My precious elvenhair rope! Those tricky elves took it. Ask about missions if you will help me find it.
keywords.light shovel: A handy reward for returning my Small Axe — lighter than a shovel!
keywords.stamped letter: The king's stamped letter — hand it to me when you wish to deliver it.
keywords.letter from al dee: Take that letter to King Tibianus so he can stamp it for Al Dee.
keywords.holy tible: The Holy Tible is yours to keep. Costello awaits it when the king sends you.
keywords.fishing rod: I sell fishing rods after you've delivered the king's stamped letter — ask me for a trade, or use one with worms in the cave waters.

confusion: I'm just a rope merchant, not a mind reader. What do you want?
These words mean nothing to me. Speak of ropes or tools!
I deal in ropes and equipment, not riddles. Be clearer!
Your meaning escapes me. Perhaps you need some rope to tie your thoughts together?
I don't understand that gibberish. Ask about my wares instead!

keywords.hi: Welcome, Player! Feel free to tell me what brings you here.
keywords.hello: Welcome, Player! Feel free to tell me what brings you here.
keywords.name: My name is Costello.
keywords.job: I'm the abbot of the White Raven Monastery on the Isle of the Kings.
keywords.isle: We founded our monastery to guard the royal tombs and to gather wisdom and knowledge.
keywords.order: We founded our monastery to guard the royal tombs and to gather wisdom and knowledge.
keywords.wisdom: You may enter the library upstairs. Don't go any further upstairs, though, as this area is reserved for members of our order.
keywords.king: The deceased leaders of the Thaian empire rest beneath this monastery in tombs and crypts.
keywords.caves: Anselm, the first monk of our order, discovered them while looking for a suitable burial place for his king.
keywords.anselm: He was a humble and pious man, and he was chosen by the royal family of Thais to find a resting place for their dead.
keywords.holy tible: The Holy Tible! Show it to me when the king sends you on the monks' study.
keywords.costello's diary: My diary tracks the seven seals of Ghostlands. Complete them and return to me.
keywords.castello's diary: My diary tracks the seven seals of Ghostlands. Complete them and return to me.
keywords.blessed ankh: The Blessed Ankh is earned when the seven seals are done. Then take it to Wyda in Venore.

confusion: I fear I do not grasp your meaning, Player. Speak of the monastery, the seals, or your mission.
Your words are unclear to me. Ask about wisdom, the king, or the caves.
I am a man of contemplation, not guesswork. What do you wish to know?
That remark puzzles me. Perhaps you meant to ask about one of the seven seals?
I cannot follow you. You may ask about Anselm, our order, or the isle.
costello.sealGuidanceFallback: The seven seals of Ghostlands must be completed one by one. I have given you my diary — it will show you which are done. Ask me about a specific seal, such as the first seal, if you wish guidance.

hi: I'm bored! Bored bored bored! Nothing ever happens here!
job: I am a witch. Didn't you notice?
I think witches these days are underpaid. Who needs a witch anyway?
profession: I am a witch. Didn't you notice?
I think witches these days are underpaid. Who needs a witch anyway?
gods: I believe that nature itself is God.
Goddess, yes, you may call me that, thank you.
nature: There are many swamp plants, mushrooms, and herbs around here.
plants: There are many kinds of swamp plants, some can be used for potions, some not.
I've heard about a whole different set of corrupted plants. I wonder what kind of potions you could make from them?
mushrooms: Mushrooms taste good and are useful for potions.
Some mushrooms have strange effects. I just recently noticed that one certain sort lets your hands grow.
herbs: The swamp is home to a wide variety of herbs, but the most famous is the blood herb.
To be honest, I'm drowning in blood herbs by now.
blood herb: The blood herb is very rare. This plant would be very useful for me, but I don't know any accessible places to find it.
To be honest, I'm drowning in blood herbs by now. But if it helps you, well yes... I guess I could use another blood herb...
bloodherb: The blood herb is very rare. This plant would be very useful for me, but I don't know any accessible places to find it.
To be honest, I'm drowning in blood herbs by now. But if it helps you, well yes... I guess I could use another blood herb...
potion: The recipe of the potions is one of the witches' secrets!
recipe: The recipe of the potions is one of the witches' secrets!
secret: The recipe of the potions is one of the witches' secrets!
magic: The magic of the witches is one of our secrets!
I want to invent a new spell. I just need a good idea.
spell: The magic of the witches is one of our secrets!
I want to invent a new spell. I just need a good idea.
key: I keep my keys where they belong - in my pocket.
Here's a secret I've never told anyone before. I actually have a key to the Kazordoon treasury. No, you can't have it.
help: I can only help with knowledge. About what do you want me to tell you something?
king: There are too many royals on this continent if you ask me...
I've heard of a new festival called 'Kingsday'. Why don't they make a 'Witchday'?
tibianus: Haha, that's a stupid name. Who's that?
queen eloise: Eloise is Queen of Carlin. I don't care about royals much, as long as they don't try to tax me.
She has become kinda fat over the years, don't you think? Ha... nothing beats some good gossip. I feel almost entertained.
eloise: Eloise is Queen of Carlin. I don't care about royals much, as long as they don't try to tax me.
She has become kinda fat over the years, don't you think? Ha... nothing beats some good gossip. I feel almost entertained.
name: My name is Wyda, and what's yours?
You should know me after all these years!
quest: A quest? Well, if you're so keen on doing me a favour... Why don't you try to find a blood herb?
To be honest, I'm drowning in blood herbs by now.
time: I think it is the fourth year after Queen Eloise's crowning, but I cannot tell you date or time.
It's about time SOMETHING HAPPENED HERE!
swamp: Be careful of the swamp water, it's poisonous!
Swamp water is good for your skin.
druid: Druids are mostly fine people. I'm always happy when I meet one.
Being a druid is fine, you know. Since household injuries are among the most common, you can at least mend your own wounds well.
sorcerer: Sorcerers have forgotten about the root of all beings: nature.
I wouldn't mind learning a new spell or two. Maybe I should dabble some in sorcerer magic.
knight: Knights succumb to the blindness of rage and the desire for violence and blood.
Even a knight would be a welcome distraction right now. I could use his little sword to poke him in the eye.
paladin: Paladins can use bows, but not brains.
I once knew a paladin who had a magic lamp. No wait... different story.
monsters: Many creatures live in, around, and beneath the swamp. Be careful!
creatures: Many creatures live in, around, and beneath the swamp. Be careful!
black knight: A black knight? Black is the color of witches, why would any knight carry black?
Many creatures live in, around, and beneath the swamp. Be careful... MWIHIHIHIHIHI.
bonelords: Bonelords? Strange creatures that have mysterious magical abilities.
giant spider: Yes, there is such a thing in the east, on a small island. It's very powerful.
hunter: To the east, there is a little settlement of hunters. They are cruel humans who attack everything they see.
To hunt or to be hunted, I guess it's either of the two.
slime: There's lots of slime around. It is said that they live from the swamp water.
witches: Some sisters of mine are having a meeting nearby. Don't disturb them, or they will get angry and attack you.
They never let me join their parties. It's not my fault that I'm smarter and prettier than them. They're just jealous!
sister: Some sisters of mine are having a meeting nearby. Don't disturb them, or they will get angry and attack you.
They never let me join their parties. It's not my fault that I'm smarter and prettier than them. They're just jealous!
cookie: I bake cookies now and then in my spare time.
I was so bored that I made cookies with insects in them. I sold them in Venore. Maybe you ate one recently.
wand: I use a wooden spellwand. Why are you asking?
I use a wooden wand. Why are you asking?
crystal ball: It's a magical item that only witches can use.
Let me take a look... ah, yes, you'll have a good day. Or maybe a bad one. Doesn't really say it clearly.
coffin: Want to end up in one? Keep your nose out!
fly broom: Haha, no... where did you get that idea? I use it to sweep my platform.
fly: Haha, no... where did you get that idea? I use it to sweep my platform.
orange: I love exotic fruits. I have oranges imported from the south sometimes, but that's very expensive.
Actually, I feel more like mangos.
carlin: Carlin is a beautiful town, but far from here. Do you live there?
I've heard a band of male bards plays there sometimes. Maybe I should pay it a visit.
kazordoon: Isn't that the name of the little bearded fellows' town?
Ah, the pretty city of... dullness.
little bearded fellows: The little bearded fellows have a town somewhere to the north-west.
dwarf: The little bearded fellows have a town somewhere to the north-west.
dwarves: The little bearded fellows have a town somewhere to the north-west.
thais: I've heard stories about that city. It's nowhere near here, that's all I can tell you about it.
plains of havoc: Many tales exist about some so-called Plains of Havoc. It seems to be a dangerous place.
The Plains of Havoc... ah, fond memories. I used to go there as a little witch and run from all the giant spiders. How scary!
dwarven bridge: There's a bridge to the west, but it's guarded by dwarfs.
Good if you don't want to get your feet wet, I guess. Hey, actually that's a brilliant idea. I could destroy a few bridges... hahaha.
earthquakes: The earth in this region shakes now and then. Foolish people think that this is because the gods are angry.
ferumbras: Haha, that's a stupid name. Who's that?
evil: I'm not evil. What are you implying?
tibia: Tibia is the name of our continent.
You're a smart one, aren't you?
health: I do not have any potions for healing available right now.
platform: This platform and house were built by my mother, long ago.
mother: Of course my mother was also a witch!
voodoo: I don't practice such nonsense, that's just a rumour.
I've recently met that fellow Chondur on a convention. He has some... interesting... skills. *giggles*
granny weatherwax: I think I've heard that name before...
nanny ogg: I think I've heard that name before...
sell: There's nothing I need right now, thanks.
see you: Good luck on your journeys, Player.
NO! Don't go! I need someone to entertain me!
bye: NO! Don't go! I need someone to entertain me!
goodbye: NO! Don't go! I need someone to entertain me!
blessed ankh: The Blessed Ankh! Costello sent you? Give it to me when you are on that task.
spider silk: Spider silk from the mother of all spiders — bring it when you accept my task.
spool of yarn: I spin spider silk into yarn. Bring me the silk from the mother of all spiders, or if you already have a spool from me, a stranded sailor might need it more than I do.

confusion: What? I have no idea what you mean. Ask me about herbs, mushrooms, or the swamp.
Hmm? That made no sense. I'm bored enough without riddles.
Speak plainly, or leave me to my potions.
Your words drift past me like fog. Try plants, magic, or the wetland.
I don't care for nonsense. Ask about witches, potions, or blood herbs.

keywords.akh'rah uthun: I don't really understand this concept, but from what I know it is the three components that make up every being.
keywords.akh rah uthun: I don't really understand this concept, but from what I know it is the three components that make up every being.
keywords.oldpharaoh: This poor man could not comprehend his son's wisdom. Perhaps he has spelled his own eternal doom.
keywords.ab'dendriel: Most elves lack the sincerity to strive for ascension. At least that's what the priests are telling us.
keywords.false gods: These greedy beings are trying to devour us all. May the pharaoh thwart their evil plans and free us from their reign of terror!
keywords.ankrahmun: This city is both a refuge and centre of learning for the believers of the true faith taught by his divine majesty the pharaoh.
keywords.kazordoon: Dwarves have a strong Akh. This makes them arrogant and deaf to the true creed.
keywords.darashia: Those poor souls there might still be saved if only they listened.
keywords.daraman: He was a great man. If he had left his mortal existence behind he might have become one of the greatest prophets of the true faith, second only to the pharaoh himself.
keywords.mortality: Mortality can be overcome. It is a sickness, but it can be cured through undeath.
keywords.ascension: Oh, I am not asking for much, you know. I mean, I really don't have to be a god or something. All I wish for is a bit of the wisdom that comes with ascension.
pharaoh: He is the benevolent father of this nation. Blessed be our saviour.
The pharaoh has such amazing patience with us puny mortals. He is truly a caring father of this nation.
keywords.dwarves: Dwarves have a strong Akh. This makes them arrogant and deaf to the true creed.
keywords.dwarfes: Dwarves have a strong Akh. This makes them arrogant and deaf to the true creed.
keywords.carlin: Those cities are so far away. So far that the enlightened preachings of our divine pharaoh cannot reach those poor misguided souls.
keywords.thais: Those cities are so far away. So far that the enlightened preachings of our divine pharaoh cannot reach those poor misguided souls.

thankYouLines: You had a few hard times last year, I know. Considering all that you did well and I'm proud of you.
You're one of my favourite children, little Player. But pssht, don't tell the others! I love all of you, of course.
Oh, little Player, watching you from above always makes my heart smile. I'll be looking forward to seeing you next Christmas!
Yes, you should thank me! I ignored that evil thing you did last year and gave you a present anyway. You know what I mean.
You've been so good during the last year that I was almost tempted to give you a Ferumbras' hat. But I didn't want to make the other children jealous.
Keep up this friendliness and politeness and we shall see about a really cool present next year!
Oh — you absolutely deserve it! You've behaved really well this year. Almost no bad things about you in my book!
Your good and bad deeds are pretty balanced. If you try and lean more towards the good side, I'll consider giving you a really nice present next year!
May the coming year be full of joy, happiness and love for you! You don't always have to be on the tough side, you know.
Thank you too, little Player, for coming to see me this year.
confusion: Ho ho ho? I didn't catch that. Ask me for a present!
Merry—wait, what? Say thank you or ask for a present, little one.
Ho ho! That's not something Santa understands. Try asking for a present.
My ears are old, but that still made no sense. Ho ho ho!
Little Player, I only understand wishes, presents, and Christmas cheer.

rumourLines: A sailor from Carlin swore the tribes in the far north pray to powers older than kings. He couldn't tell whether he meant gods... or the wind itself.
Dock gossip says there are birds in the north that never take wing, yet rule the shoreline all the same. Sounds absurd, but sailors keep repeating it.
They say northern folk dine on fish of every color and call it a feast fit for warriors...
...I still don't trust anything brighter than blue on a plate.
One miner came back from the far north shaking and sleepless, muttering about buried halls and things best left buried.
A friend of mine, Captain Ogden Brewboiler, sailed beyond the known charts. Brave man... but I still watch the horizon for his return.
The stories about northern clans never agree with each other...
...allies in one tavern tale, enemies in the next.
People speak of a towering ice crown in the heart of the northern isles, visible even through storm haze.
Old sailors tell a creation-war legend: that mages chained winter itself in crystal, and the north never thawed again.
For years, captains feared serpent-haunted waters around the northern passage...
...then, one season, the routes opened as if the sea had changed its mind.
A sailor swore some northern raiders can command wolves and bears like trained hounds...
...tavern nonsense, perhaps — though he had the scars to support his tale.
Last week an old drunk muttered about tusked beasts with fur thick as winter cloaks. If half these stories are true, the north is wilder than maps admit.
Rumours name a fierce northern tribe ruled by a shaman no storm or steel can bring down.
Traders claim some northern settlements burn through timber faster than ships burn tar...
...where wood runs short, merchants smell profit.
Word from the frontier says rival warbands contest the north, and each season redraws the lines.
I received a letter from a friend stationed in the north...
...he mentioned trials, secretive locals, and rites for outsiders. The ink was shaking the whole way down the page.
A broker told me the Carlin Trading Syndicate is planting new banners in every northern port that stays open long enough.
Venore hunters reportedly settled on one island and now ship back rare pelts, oils, and stranger things.
Expedition after expedition goes north chasing ore and old workings beneath the ice...
...not all of them return on schedule.
There are tales of horned cave-folk beneath one of the smaller ice islands — half traveler, half beast...
Witnesses claim their caverns grow green grass and flowers beneath frozen stone. That smells like old magic to me...
Whether that magic is a blessing or a warning, no one agrees.

santa-claus.fishing_rod: Al Dee sells fishing rods if you want to catch something.
santa-claus.light_shovel: Al Dee gives a Light Shovel to helpful adventurers.
santa-claus.holy_tible: Holy books belong at Costello's monastery.
santa-claus.costello_diary: Costello's diary tracks seven spooky seals — brr!
santa-claus.blessed_ankh: Blessed ankhs go to Wyda in the swamps, not under my tree.
santa-claus.scarab_coin: Scarab coins are Tesha's trade in the hot desert.
santa-claus.destroy_field_rune: Magic runes in the Serpentine Tower — ask Tesha.
santa-claus.compass: Tesha rewards brave souls with a Compass.
santa-claus.spider_silk: Spider silk is for Wyda the witch in Venore.
santa-claus.spool_of_yarn: Wyda spins spider silk into yarn.
santa-claus.yarn: Yarn from Wyda's spiders — not from Santa's elves!
santa-claus.obsidian_knife: Obsidian knives are for dragon hunters, not gift wrapping.
santa-claus.dragon_claw: A dragon claw! Ferumbras would be jealous, ho ho ho!
santa-claus.wooden_plank: A wooden plank from Rookstayer's brave battle.
santa-claus.map_to_mines: That map leads to mines — the king's key is down there.
santa-claus.silver_token: The king's silver token — show it when you hail him in Thais.

rookstayer.wooden_plank: A wooden plank — proof you stood with me against Apprentice Sheng!
rookstayer.honeyflower: Once you brought the king his honeyflower, you found the courage to help me.
rookstayer.copper_key: The king's key is lost in the mines — I have troubles of my own here.
rookstayer.red_dragon_leather: Dragon materials are the king's errand. I face minotaurs, not dragons.
rookstayer.red_dragon_scale: Hunt dragons for the king if you must — Sheng is my concern.
rookstayer.letter_from_al_dee: Letters and ropes are Al Dee's business in Rookgaard.
rookstayer.stamped_letter: Deliver stamped letters to Al Dee, adventurer.
rookstayer.iron_ore: Iron ore for the king — I need your help here, not in Thais.
rookstayer.small_axe: Al Dee's axe is at the bottom of cave waters in Rookgaard.
rookstayer.elvenhair_rope: Al Dee mourns his stolen elvenhair rope.
rookstayer.magnet: A magnet might fish Al Dee's axe from the depths.
rookstayer.fishing_rod: Al Dee sells rods for fishing in Rookgaard's waters.
rookstayer.light_shovel: Al Dee rewards a Light Shovel for finding his axe.
rookstayer.holy_tible: Costello at the White Raven Monastery studies such tomes.
rookstayer.costello_diary: Costello's diary and the seven seals — a monk's burden.
rookstayer.blessed_ankh: Wyda in Venore needs the Blessed Ankh from Costello's task.
rookstayer.scarab_coin: Scarab coins are traded in the Darama desert by Tesha.
rookstayer.destroy_field_rune: Desert runes and towers — far from this minotaur room.
rookstayer.compass: Tesha rewards a Compass after the Putrid Chamber.
rookstayer.spider_silk: Spider silk for Wyda's witchcraft in the Venore swamps.
rookstayer.spool_of_yarn: Wyda spins spider silk into yarn.
rookstayer.yarn: Yarn from Wyda — I have no time for spinning.
rookstayer.obsidian_knife: Skin dragons for the king if you wish — Sheng awaits us.
rookstayer.dragon_claw: A dragon claw trophy — impressive, but will you help me now?
rookstayer.map_to_mines: The king's map leads to the mines — will you help me here first?
rookstayer.wishlist: A wishlist? Santa Claus in Folda reads those.
rookstayer.christmas_present: Christmas presents come from Santa in Folda.
rookstayer.present: Ask Santa for presents — I need help defeating Apprentice Sheng!
rookstayer.bunny_slippers: Cozy slippers from Santa — but Sheng still threatens us!
rookstayer.silver_token: Show the king's silver token when you hail King Tibianus.

svenson.wishlist: Santa handles wishlists in Folda. I handle ferries.
svenson.christmas_present: Ask Santa in Folda about presents. I can get you there by sea.
svenson.present: Presents are Santa's concern. Ferries are mine.
svenson.bunny_slippers: Warm slippers for cold decks. If Dane is waiting, those are the gift I promised her.
svenson.honeyflower: A flower for the king? I only ship passengers and goods.
svenson.copper_key: A key for the king's mines? Best bring it to Thais.
svenson.red_dragon_leather: Dragon cargo sounds heavy, but that's a royal errand.
svenson.red_dragon_scale: Those scales belong to the king's forge, not my hold.
svenson.letter_from_al_dee: A merchant letter? Deliver it to its owner in Rookgaard.
svenson.stamped_letter: Stamped letters are for Al Dee, not for ferrymen.
svenson.iron_ore: Ore can be shipped, but King Tibianus wants to see that himself.
svenson.small_axe: Al Dee lost an axe in Rookgaard waters, if tales are true.
svenson.elvenhair_rope: Al Dee's rope business sounds tangled enough already.
svenson.magnet: A magnet might help in deep waters.
svenson.fishing_rod: A good rod is useful at sea. Al Dee sells them.
svenson.light_shovel: A light shovel is handy cargo.
svenson.holy_tible: A holy tome belongs with Costello at the monastery.
svenson.costello_diary: A monk's diary is safer on land than at sea.
svenson.blessed_ankh: Wyda in Venore would know what to do with that relic.
svenson.scarab_coin: Scarab coin? Tesha in Darama trades those.
svenson.destroy_field_rune: A dangerous rune. Best ask Tesha about desert magic.
svenson.compass: A fine navigator's tool. If we are lost below the waves, give it to me when I ask.
svenson.spider_silk: Spider silk from Venore swamps is no cargo I enjoy — but yarn spun from it mends sails.
svenson.spool_of_yarn: Fine yarn for patching hull seams. Give it to me when the ship needs a quick repair.
svenson.yarn: Yarn for patching seams. Give it to me when I ask for a Spool of Yarn.
svenson.obsidian_knife: An obsidian blade should be handled with care aboard ship.
svenson.dragon_claw: A dragon claw trophy? That's a fine story to carry.
svenson.wooden_plank: A wooden plank looks perfect for emergency hull repairs. Give it to me when I ask.
svenson.map_to_mines: A map to the mines points inland, not across the sea.
svenson.silver_token: The king's silver token is for your first audience in Thais.
svenson.orb: A glowing orb from Dane's thanks — keep it safe ashore.

dane.orb: That orb is yours for defeating Ghazbaran. May it serve you well.
dane.bunny_slippers: Svenson promised me bunny slippers. Warm feet for a cold cellar!
dane.wishlist: Wishlists belong with Santa Claus, not behind my bar.
dane.christmas_present: Ask Santa for presents — I pour drinks.
dane.present: Ask Santa for presents — I pour drinks.
dane.wooden_plank: A plank for Svenson's hull? Take it to him on Folda Boat.
dane.spool_of_yarn: Yarn for sail repairs? Svenson needs that more than I do.
dane.yarn: Yarn for sail repairs? Svenson needs that more than I do.
dane.compass: A compass for lost sailors — Svenson would know what to do with it.
dane.honeyflower: Honeyflowers are the king's tea, not my specialty.
dane.copper_key: The king's key belongs in Thais, not White Wave Cellar.
dane.red_dragon_leather: Dragon leather? Too rough for my tables.
dane.red_dragon_scale: Dragon scales belong at the royal forge.
dane.letter_from_al_dee: Letters from Rookgaard merchants are not my affair.
dane.stamped_letter: Deliver stamped letters to Al Dee.
dane.iron_ore: Iron ore is the king's interest.
dane.small_axe: Al Dee lost his axe in Rookgaard.
dane.elvenhair_rope: Al Dee's rope troubles are far from this cellar.
dane.magnet: Magnets and fishing are Al Dee's or the king's business.
dane.fishing_rod: Al Dee sells fishing rods on Rookgaard.
dane.light_shovel: Al Dee's shovel reward — not for serving drinks.
dane.holy_tible: Holy books belong at Costello's monastery.
dane.costello_diary: A monk's diary belongs with Costello.
dane.blessed_ankh: Wyda in Venore deals in such relics.
dane.scarab_coin: Scarab coins are Tesha's trade in Darama.
dane.spider_silk: Spider silk is Wyda's trade in the Venore swamps.
dane.obsidian_knife: A hunter's knife — keep it sheathed in my cellar.
dane.dragon_claw: A dragon claw trophy! Impressive, but I prefer quiet evenings.
dane.map_to_mines: That map leads to mines, not to my bar.
dane.silver_token: Show the king's silver token when you hail him in Thais.
